title: Synthetic maintenance restoration authority boundary
provenance_detail: Original synthetic workflow-safety note authored for ShopfloorPilot's operator-confirmed restoration contract.

chunks.evidence_excerpt: Only an explicit operator or scenario-harness confirmation may restore a synthetic machine. A diagnostic hypothesis, retrieved note, improved reading, or passage of simulated time cannot declare repair complete or change machine availability.
observable_symptoms: machine remains unavailable while checks are pending
readings improve without an explicit restoration event
suggested_checks: Record inspection or measurement results as observations.
Ask the authorized operator or scenario harness for an explicit restoration decision.
Keep diagnostic output separate from the state-changing restoration action.
limitations: This note defines authority for the synthetic application only.
It supplies no repair procedure and never represents completed maintenance.
